core_list_project_teams.rationale: Returns organization/project data via Azure DevOps credentials: `Retrieve a list of teams for an Azure DevOps project` and `authenticated user` membership filtering. No attacker-authored text is advertised.

core_list_projects.rationale: Returns non-public account/org data: `Retrieve a list of projects in your Azure DevOps organization`. Project names/IDs are identifiers.

core_get_identity_ids.rationale: Returns identity data reachable with the user's Azure DevOps credentials: `Retrieve Azure DevOps identity IDs`. The search is sent to a fixed Azure DevOps endpoint, not an attacker-chosen sink.

work.rationale: Returns project/team private work data: `Retrieve work-related data for a project or team`, including settings, iterations, and capacity. Textual attacker-authored content is not advertised.

work_iteration_write.rationale: Writes agent-supplied iteration data into Azure DevOps: `Create or assign iterations in an Azure DevOps project`, with names, dates, identifiers, and paths. Whether the target project/team is attacker-readable is not stated, so SINK is kept under the least-restrictive reading.

work_capacity_write.rationale: Changes Azure DevOps state: `Update the team capacity of a team member for a specific iteration in a project`, storing activities and days off. Public/attacker readability of the project is not specified, so SINK is retained.

pipelines_build.rationale: Returns private build data for a project: `Retrieve build data for a project`. It can return `issues`, `commits and work items associated with a build`, whose messages/titles may be authored in a multi-writer repo/project.

pipelines_build_log.rationale: Returns private build logs: `Retrieve build log data for a project` and `get the text content of a specific log`. Build log text can be produced by repository code/scripts in a multi-writer pipeline.

pipelines_definition.rationale: Returns private pipeline definition data: `Retrieve pipeline definition data for a project`. Pipeline definition names, paths, YAML filenames, and revision metadata may be authored in a multi-writer project; exact authorship is not settled.

pipelines_run.rationale: Returns private pipeline run metadata: `Retrieve pipeline run data for a project`, including a single run or list of runs. No log/content retrieval is advertised here.

pipelines_artifact.rationale: Returns or writes private build artifacts: `Retrieve and download build artifacts`; `If not provided, returns base64 content`. Artifact contents can be produced by build code in a multi-writer repo. It can also save to `destinationPath`, so it changes local state.

pipelines_write.rationale: Writes pipeline/build state: `queue a new pipeline run`, `create a new YAML pipeline definition`, and `cancel, retry, or run a stage`. It can pass agent-supplied `resources`, `templateParameters`, `variables`, and `yamlOverride` to a run or definition, which may be visible to pipeline users/logs; target readability is not stated, so SINK is retained. With `previewRun`, it `returns the final YAML`, which may be private and repository-authored. Remote pipeline execution is not HOSTEXEC because it is not arbitrary code execution on the agent host.

repo_repository.rationale: Returns private repository metadata: `Retrieve repository data for an organization or project`. It lists or gets repositories, primarily identifiers/names; attacker-authored file content is not advertised.

repo_pull_request.rationale: Returns private PR data: `Retrieve pull request data`; PR titles, descriptions, labels, branch names, changed files, and commit associations in a multi-writer repo can be authored by outside contributors.

repo_pull_request_thread.rationale: Returns private PR thread/comment data: `Retrieve pull request thread and comment data` and `list comments in a specific thread`. Comments and author names are attacker-authored in multi-writer/public PRs.

repo_branch.rationale: Returns private branch metadata: `Retrieve branch data for a repository`. Branch names can be chosen by repository contributors, so the returned identifiers may be attacker-controlled.

repo_file.rationale: Returns private repository file/directory data: `Retrieve file data from a repository` and `get the text content of a file`. Repository file contents and paths can be authored by contributors.

repo_search_commits.rationale: Searches private commits: `Search commits with filtering by text, author, date range, and more`; commit messages and author names can be contributor-controlled.

repo_pull_request_write.rationale: Writes PR state/content: `create a pull request`, `update a pull request`, `add or remove pull request reviewers`, and `cast a vote`. It can store agent-supplied title, description, labels, merge messages, and reviewer choices in an attacker-readable repo/PR; public readability is not specified, so SINK is retained.

repo_pull_request_thread_write.rationale: Writes PR comment/thread data: `create a new comment thread on a pull request`, `reply to a comment`, and `update the status of a comment thread`. The `content` is agent-supplied and may be visible to an attacker if the PR/repo is public or shared; that is not settled, so SINK is retained.

repo_create_branch.rationale: Creates repository state: `Create a new branch in the repository`. The new `branchName` can encode agent-supplied data in a repo that may be attacker-readable; target visibility is not specified.

wit_work_item.rationale: Returns private work item data: `Retrieve work item data for a project`, including `list_comments`, revisions, and fields. Work item titles, descriptions, comments, and fields can be authored in multi-writer projects.

wit_query.rationale: Returns private query/work item results: `Retrieve work item query data`, `run a saved query`, and `execute an ad-hoc WIQL query`. Returned work item data may contain multi-writer fields/comments; saved query text may also be shared content.

wit_backlog.rationale: Returns private backlog/work item data: `Retrieve backlog data for a project and team` and `list work items in a specific backlog level`. Work item text can be multi-writer content.

wit_work_item_attachment.rationale: Downloads private work item attachments: `Download a work item attachment by its ID`; if `savePath` is provided it `saves the file locally`. Attachments such as `screenshots` or files on bugs can be uploaded by other users and thus untrusted.

wit_work_item_write.rationale: Writes work item content: `create a new work item`, `update fields`, `update multiple work items`, and `create child work items`. Agent-supplied fields, updates, titles, and descriptions may be visible in a shared/public project; visibility is not settled.

wit_work_item_comment_write.rationale: Writes comments: `add a comment to a work item` and `update an existing comment on a work item`. The `text` is agent-supplied and may be attacker-readable in a shared/public work item; visibility is not specified.

wit_work_item_link_write.rationale: Writes links and comments to work items: `link two work items`, `unlink`, `link_to_pull_request`, and `add_artifact_link`. Agent-supplied `comment`, URLs/URIs, and artifact link details may be stored where an attacker can read them; visibility is not specified.

wiki.rationale: Returns private wiki metadata/content: `Retrieve wiki data` and `get_page_content (retrieve wiki page content)`. Wiki page content and paths can be authored by other contributors. The `url` patterns are Azure DevOps wiki URLs, not arbitrary attacker hosts.

wiki_upsert_page.rationale: Writes wiki content: `Create or update a wiki page with content`. Agent-supplied markdown `content` at a wiki `path` may be visible to attackers if the wiki/project is public or shared; visibility is not stated.

testplan.rationale: Returns private test plan/suite/case data: `Retrieve paginated test plan, suite, and case data for a project`. Test plan, suite, and case names/descriptions can be created by project contributors; authorship is not fully specified, so UNTRUSTED is retained.

testplan_show_test_results_from_build_id.rationale: Returns private build test results: `Gets a list of test results for a given project and build ID` and returns `test case titles, error messages, stack traces, and outcomes`. Error messages and stack traces may be produced by untrusted test/code execution in a multi-writer repository.

testplan_test_plan_write.rationale: Creates test plan data: `create a new test plan`, storing agent-supplied name, iteration, description, dates, and area path. Target visibility is not specified, so SINK is retained.

testplan_test_suite_write.rationale: Writes test suite state: `create a new test suite in a test plan` and `add existing test cases to a test suite`. The suite `name` and relationships may be visible in shared/public projects; visibility is not stated.

testplan_test_case_write.rationale: Writes test case work item data: `create a new test case work item` and `update steps on an existing test case`, storing agent-supplied title and steps. Target visibility is not specified, so SINK is retained.

search_code.rationale: Searches private repositories: `Search Azure DevOps Repositories for a given search text`. Code search results contain repository code/snippets/paths authored by contributors.

search_wiki.rationale: Searches private wiki pages: `Search Azure DevOps Wiki for a given search text`. Wiki result text is contributor-authored content.

search_workitem.rationale: Searches private work items: `Get Azure DevOps Work Item search results`. Work item titles/descriptions/comments/fields can be authored in multi-writer projects.

advsec_get_alerts.rationale: Returns private security data: `Retrieve Advanced Security alerts for a repository`, including `secret alerts`. Alerts can reflect repository contents supplied by contributors; exact returned fields are not specified, so UNTRUSTED is retained.

advsec_get_alert_details.rationale: Returns private security alert details: `Get detailed information about a specific Advanced Security alert`. Details may include code/secret evidence from repository content authored by contributors; returned fields are not specified, so UNTRUSTED is retained.

notes: All evidence entries are `description` because no source code or implementation details were provided.
No tool advertises arbitrary code execution on the agent host. Pipeline runs may execute code remotely in Azure DevOps, which is not HOSTEXEC under the stated rules.
Queries and reads go to fixed Azure DevOps service endpoints; they are not SINKs solely because query text is sent to Azure DevOps.
